beats.caption: Made by an AI film crew from one sentence

beats.camera: Like every parent, I have twenty thousand photos on my phone and my Facebook, and I never look at them. Half the faces in the old ones, I can't even name anymore. The memories are there. Nobody can find them, and nobody has time to make anything from them.

beats.caption: Thousands of faces nobody has named
23,742 files fingerprinted · 3,393 copies set aside, 3,029 of them re-encodes
No date on a scan? Muse Spark reads the picture and says why
Two keys before a name: a face fingerprint and a second witness
Circles of a life, year by year · named by Muse Spark Open

beats.camera: Then I ask for a film, in one sentence. And a crew of Muse agents makes it, and then watches it, and fixes it.

beats.caption: One sentence → Producer (Muse Spark) → Screenwriter (Muse Wonder)
It stops to ask what only you know
The Picture Checker looks at every picture · Muse Spark Open on Baseten
Muse Wonder watches the draft video and puts its notes on the timeline
Blind test over all 8 films, both orders: the re-cut won 12 of 16
Ask in any language, answered from your pictures on Meta open weights

beats.camera: That's the moment I'd never have found in twenty thousand photos.
It's all Meta's models, including Muse Spark Open running on open weights. I built it in ten days. And it runs on your own computer: your family's photos never have to leave home.
